name: C.D.C.D.2
original_name: C.D.C.D.2 ～シーディーシーディー2～
source:
Fandisk for several Circus games.
--------------------------------------------
First story is about the positions in which the newlyweds Nemu and Junichi liked to have sex. A close-to-nukige story with the heroes of "Da Capo".
Second story tells us what happened to a man who lost everything in his life except for a faithful maid. It's a very psychologically difficult story about the characters of "Home Maid" vn.
Third story may slightly recover your mood with a small fantasy on the theme of uninhibited relationships of Yoshiyuki, Nanaka and Koko, the heroes of "Da Capo II".
Last story is a variation on the theme of "Beauty and the Beast," where the main character is Euretta from "Eternal Fantasy". Here you'll find an unexpected plot twist and shocking events that will happen to the main heroine.
translation:
Circus旗下多部游戏的粉丝光盘。
--------------------------------------------
第一个故事讲述了新婚夫妇音梦和纯一喜欢的体位，是《Da Capo》主人公们的一段接近拔作的故事。
第二个故事讲述了一个失去了一切、只忠心于一位女仆的男人的遭遇。这是关于《Home Maid》角色的一段心理描写极为沉重的故事。
第三个故事可能会稍微恢复你的心情——以《Da Capo II》的主人公义之、菜花和可可为主角，讲述一段关于无拘无束的恋爱关系的小幻想。
最后一个故事是"美女与野兽"的变奏，主人公是《Eternal Fantasy》中的尤蕾塔。在这里，你将遭遇出人意料的剧情转折和震撼事件。
